Question: Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu Dear Ulmayekiram, My question is as follows: 1) Why there was need for creations of 4 imams ? for ex. I would be very grateful to you, knowing the answers of above questions. Jazhakumullahu kairah Answer ID: 20300 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 564/368/L=1431) Study the book "Mutala Ghair Muqallidiyat" by Maulana Amin Safdar Saheb, and "Alkalamul Mufeed Fi Isbatit Taqlid" by Maulana Sarfaraz Safdar Khan ( رحمة الله ).
